def solve(T):
    H,W=len(T),len(T[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in T for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c,T[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if T[r][c]!=bg]
    # template = largest connected component of non-bg
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for p in cells:
        r,c=p[0],p[1]
        if (r,c) in seen: continue
        st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
        while st:
            rr,cc=st.pop()
            if (rr,cc) in seen: continue
            seen.add((rr,cc)); comp.append((rr,cc))
            st+= [(rr+1,cc),(rr-1,cc),(rr,cc+1),(rr,cc-1)]
        comps.append(comp)
    comps.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
    tpl=comps[0]; markers=[p for comp in comps[1:] for p in comp]
    rs=[p[0] for p in tpl]; cs=[p[1] for p in tpl]
    m_r=m_c=int(round((min(rs)+max(rs))/2)), int(round((min(cs)+max(cs))/2))
    rel=[(r-m_r,c-m_c,v) for r,c,v in tpl]
    res=[row[:] for row in T]
    for r,c,_ in markers:
        for dr,dc,v in rel:
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W:
                res[nr][nc]=v
    return res
